estimator.note: Estimates only. Origin synthetic; a prediction is never a recorded price and is retained as historical evidence when its target hour passes.

notes: Crypto trades 24/7: buckets align to 00:00 UTC, not an equity session open. There is no session filter.
Every prediction is a One Clock observation with origin "synthetic", session "continuous", eventAt at the target hour's start. Live prices and future estimates stay in separate cohorts.
CoinGecko-labelled coins have no 1h base: CoinGecko free OHLC has no 1m/1h series, so they have no prediction by design and are labelled absent, never interpolated from daily bars.
